seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Mirror-axis puzzle modelled as hidden sprites on a 3x3-block lattice: horizontal axis wall, static targets, holed pieces, and gray reflections of each piece mirrored across the axis centre row.
ACTION5 cycles the selection axis -> pieces -> axis. ACTION1-4 move the selection by 3 cells (x=row: 1 up, 2 down, 3 left, 4 right); the axis only moves vertically.
Render layers wall1<target2<reflection3<piece4. A hole is transparent if a lower layer is under it, otherwise filled (selected piece/axis dots 0, reflection 4). Objects are re-extracted as components sorted by bbox (x,y), with each target as its own object, and wall_h index offset by the count of 0 pixels outside walls.
Hidden state (continuity-gated) keeps sprite identity when pieces merge, plus the cycle order and fully hidden targets. All 29 transitions also pass with hidden state disabled.
Untested guesses: blocking rules (board edges, axis, other pieces; the axis is blocked by pieces), ACTION6/7 as no-ops, and the cycle order on
